subject: Surge true‑up & PO timing question
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Cho <helen@glowware.ai>
Cc: Markus Green <markus@glowware.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Feb 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Surge true‑up & PO timing question

Hi Helen / Markus —

Thanks again for the transparency on last week's traffic spike. We reviewed the usage and there was a ~4.3x temporary increase in token consumption during the 48‑hour window. Per your contract the overrun will be assessed as a true‑up for the month of February.

I want to avoid any billing surprises for your Finance team — two quick items:
1) We can offer a one‑time mitigation credit of 40% on the overrun portion if Glowware agrees to a provisional PO that covers the baseline + the accelerated month within seven business days. This is a special short‑window offer to smooth your landing.
2) Alternatively, if you prefer to absorb the overrun without a PO, we'll invoice at standard overrun rates and you can apply for a post‑invoicing appeal (longer process; credit not guaranteed).

I've attached a provisional quote that shows the math for both paths (baseline + overrun, with the 40% one‑time credit applied). Can you confirm which route your procurement prefers and an ETA for the PO? If you pick the PO path, we'll send an amendment to sign and immediately apply the credit to the March invoice schedule.

Attachment: provisional_trueup_quote.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0128

On internal note: Laura / Priyom — looping you in for visibility. If Finance/Legal need precedent language for the amendment, I can fast‑track a draft.

From: Helen Cho <helen@glowware.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Green <markus@glowware.ai>, Glowware Procurement <procurement@glowware.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Feb 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Surge true‑up & PO timing question

Hi Aditya —

Appreciate the quick breakdown and the credit offer. Procurement prefers the PO route so the overrun is covered cleanly. Two clarifying asks before we commit:
• Can you confirm the credit will be applied to the invoice immediately rather than as a future credit line? We need that for our month‑end close.
• Our PO team needs the legal exhibit language for the amendment (simple short form is fine). Can you send the amendment doc and the expected timeline for countersign?

We aim to get the PO to you by next Wednesday (3/5). If you can send the amendment now we can circulate it to Legal.

Thanks,
Helen
Head of Platform Engineering, Glowware AI
helen@glowware.ai

Thanks for the context. Finance OK on provisional application of the credit once a valid PO is received, provided:
• PO references deal ID DW‑4721 and indicates "provisional true‑up payment" as the line item; and
• We receive the PO within seven business days of the amendment being transmitted.

Legal reviewed the attached draft. Two minor edits (non‑substantive):
1) Replace the phrase "will apply immediately" with "may be applied at Redwood's discretion upon receipt of PO" to preserve invoicing control.
2) Add a 30‑day rollback clause in the amendment to allow correction if the PO terms are misaligned (standard control).

If Aditya is comfortable with those small edits I'll produce a signed PDF and circulate for countersign. Once countersigned we'll mark the March invoice as adjusted and push the credit through our billing system.
